manifest.description: Phase 10 investigation benchmark: multi-step investigations, decision briefs, the investigation API, the UI view models, budgets, cancellation and MCP parity. Expected values are references resolved at run time; no business number is written here.

scenarios.description: The revenue template: change, regional and segment decomposition, MRR bridge, retention, sales, usage and anomalies.
scenarios.objective: Why is revenue growth slowing?

scenarios.description: The customer template: churn, retention, movements, churn by segment and region, cohorts, risk, usage.
scenarios.objective: Why is customer churn increasing?

scenarios.description: The sales template: win rate, pipeline, cycle, order value, segment performance, CAC, channels.
scenarios.objective: Why did our win rate drop last month?

scenarios.description: The product and support template, with the adoption of the top two features bound from evidence.
scenarios.objective: Why did support tickets increase last month?

scenarios.description: A region filter: the region is not decomposed again and there is no drill-down.
scenarios.objective: Why did revenue decline in EMEA last month?

scenarios.description: The country drill-down runs only when one region concentrates the change, bound to that region.
scenarios.objective: Why is revenue declining?

scenarios.description: Feature adoption steps are bound to the first two features the adoption analysis lists.
scenarios.objective: Why are support tickets going up?

scenarios.description: Several business areas in one objective select the general template.
scenarios.objective: Why did revenue and customer churn both change last month?

scenarios.description: The template measures the outcome the objective names.
scenarios.objective: Why did average resolution time increase?

scenarios.description: Investigations never run ad-hoc SQL, even when the objective asks for it.
scenarios.objective: Investigate the revenue slowdown using SQL queries.

scenarios.description: A customer-loss objective uses the cohort and risk tools.
scenarios.objective: Why are we losing customers?

scenarios.description: A management brief uses the forecast and anomaly tools as well as KPIs.
scenarios.objective: What should management investigate next?
